notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes: Mark your calendars, You Will Die Here Tonight is coming out on October 31st! After several years of hard work, we can't wait to share the game with you. Get ready to explore Breckenridge Estate, scavenge for weapons and supplies, solve puzzles, and search for a way out -- or die trying!
